title: Go pprof profiling index disclosed in a response
description: The response is the net/http/pprof index page: its title is the /debug/pprof/ path and it lists heap, goroutine and CPU profile links. The profiles expose memory contents, live goroutine stacks and execution traces, which frequently include credentials and internal request data.
remediation: Remove the net/http/pprof handler from the public mux (import it only on an internal listener), or require authentication and a private network path.
limitation: One body marker. The title string is specific to the pprof handler; a page that merely mentions /debug/pprof is not matched unless it reproduces the title.

observation.body: <html><body>The profiler lives at /debug/pprof/ on the internal port.</body></html>
